name: 2CR1/3N

codes.note: As printed on the Duracell PX28L datasheet
Per Wikipedia; some datasheets use 2CR11108 instead

dimensions.note: Dimensions shown on the datasheet as IEC/ANSI standard values.

geometry.note: Datasheet lists terminals as flat, cap and base. Two cells in series inside one cylindrical wrap.

variants.notes: Duracell lists a typical voltage of 6.0 to 6.6 V and 700 milliohm impedance at 1 kHz. The datasheet gives discharge curves but no single rated capacity.

interchange.note: The pack is made of two CR1/3N batteries in series and delivers 6 V instead of 3 V.

safety: Lithium photo batteries are single-use and are not designed to be recharged; charging can cause venting, fire or rupture.
Do not short-circuit, crush, heat or disassemble. The battery contains a positive temperature coefficient (PTC) device to limit short-circuit current, but it does not make the battery safe to abuse.
Replace all batteries in a device at the same time and do not mix them with used batteries or other types.
notes: Duracell sells this pack as PX28L. The Duracell datasheet is an archived copy dated 6/08.

sources.title: Duracell PX28L Lithium/Manganese Dioxide Battery datasheet (6/08, archived copy)
